description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Notify the Revenue Protection Order No. 05 of 2018, which specified the Import Duties on Petroleum & Diesel
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a resolution passed by Parliament under Section 10 of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) regarding the levying of import duties on specific articles. It establishes new regulatory rates for petroleum products and other oils, making it a legal/regulatory matter concerning customs regulations and tariff modifications.
